description: This file defines the MyOpportunitiesDashlet class, a custom dashboard widget for displaying opportunities in SuiteCRM. It extends DashletGeneric, initializes dashlet properties, and includes a process fix for amount display issues.

classes.name: MyOpportunitiesDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for Opportunities, extending DashletGeneric, with custom constructor and process method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes dashlet properties including title, search fields, columns, and seedBean.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overrides parent process to fix display columns for amount fields.
